lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, roughly circular nodes organized into approximately 5-6 vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots to form a geometric, lattice-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with light-colored pixels on the dorsal edge and dark shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct gradient in spot size and density, transitioning from high-frequency small-diameter spots on the anterior head to larger, more sparsely distributed spots on the posterior flank.
